var CONFIG = {
  ODOO_API_URL:  '/api/lead/create',
  GUIDE_PDF_URL: '/sertec_landing/static/src/guia.pdf',
  DEBUG: false
};

var nameInput  = document.getElementById('lead_name');
var phoneInput = document.getElementById('lead_phone');
var zoneSelect = document.getElementById('lead_zone');
var submitBtn  = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
var responseEl = document.getElementById('response_msg');
var formBody   = document.getElementById('form_body');
var formSuccess= document.getElementById('form_success');

zoneSelect.addEventListener('change', function() {
  this.classList.toggle('filled', !!this.value);
  this.classList.remove('error');
});
nameInput.addEventListener('input',  function() { clearError('name'); });
phoneInput.addEventListener('input', function() { clearError('phone'); });

function clearError(field) {
  var el    = document.getElementById('err_' + field);
  var input = field === 'name' ? nameInput : phoneInput;
  if (el)    el.classList.remove('show');
  if (input) input.classList.remove('error');
}

function validate() {
  var valid = true;
  var name  = nameInput.value.trim();
  var phone = phoneInput.value.trim();
  if (!name || name.length < 2) {
    document.getElementById('err_name').classList.add('show');
    nameInput.classList.add('error');
    valid = false;
  }
  var phoneClean = phone.replace(/[\s\-\(\)]/g, '');
  if (!phoneClean || phoneClean.replace(/\D/g, '').length < 7) {
    document.getElementById('err_phone').classList.add('show');
    phoneInput.classList.add('error');
    valid = false;
  }
  return valid;
}

function setLoading(on) {
  submitBtn.disabled = on;
  submitBtn.classList.toggle('loading', on);
}

function showMsg(text, type) {
  responseEl.textContent = text;
  responseEl.className = 'response-msg ' + type;
}

function hideMsg() {
  responseEl.className = 'response-msg';
}

async function postLead(name, phone, zone) {
  var payload = {
    jsonrpc: '2.0',
    method:  'call',
    id:      Date.now(),
    params:  { name: name, phone: phone, zone: zone }
  };
  var res = await fetch(CONFIG.ODOO_API_URL, {
    method:  'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body:    JSON.stringify(payload)
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
  var json = await res.json();
  var result = json.result || json;
  if (result.status === 'error') throw new Error(result.message || 'Error desconocido.');
  return result;
}

submitBtn.addEventListener('click', async function() {
  hideMsg();
  if (!validate()) return;
  var name  = nameInput.value.trim();
  var phone = phoneInput.value.trim();
  var zone  = zoneSelect.value || 'No especificada';
  setLoading(true);
  try {
    await postLead(name, phone, zone);
    formBody.style.display = 'none';
    formSuccess.classList.add('visible');
    setTimeout(function() {
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = CONFIG.GUIDE_PDF_URL;
      a.download = 'Guia-Rentabilidad-EyM.pdf';
      a.target = '_blank';
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
    }, 1200);
  } catch(err) {
    showMsg('❌ ' + (err.message || 'Error al enviar. Intenta de nuevo.'), 'error');
    setLoading(false);
  }
});

document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function(a) {
  a.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    var target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));
    if (target) { e.preventDefault(); target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
  });
});
